mentions.heading: Joint ventures and alliances may not achieve anticipated benefits
mentions.risk_name: Joint venture funding and execution shortfall
mentions.detail: Alliances may carry funding or take-or-pay obligations; new JVs may miss production timing or quality targets
mentions.quote: Under the terms of current or future alliances, we may have certain obligations, including funding obligations or take or pay obligations.

mentions.heading: As our business is global, we need to comply with laws and regulations in countries across the world.
mentions.detail: U.S. EAR and EU sanctions; ceased shipments to Huawei in 2020; new U.S. administration policy changes
mentions.quote: For example, in 2020, due to regulations imposed by the U.S. government, we ceased shipments of our products to Huawei pending approval of export licenses.

mentions.heading: Global privacy legislation creating complex compliance environment
mentions.detail: EU GDPR and expanding global privacy rules; compliance costs could be significant
mentions.quote: Furthermore, global privacy legislation, enforcement, and policy activity, such as the EU General Data Privacy Regulation, are rapidly expanding and creating a complex regulatory compliance environment. Costs to comply with and implement these privacy-related and data protection measures could be significant.

mentions.heading: Restrictions on cross-border semiconductor investments
mentions.detail: Dutch foreign investment control regime and U.S. outbound investment rules may limit acquisitions and alliances
mentions.quote: In addition, governments are increasingly imposing restrictions on cross-border investments in semiconductor businesses and technology, such as the Dutch foreign investment control regime and U.S. outbound investment rules, that may limit our ability to execute strategic acquisitions, investments and alliances, any of which could have a material adverse effect on our business.

mentions.heading: Legal proceedings covering a range of matters are pending in various jurisdictions.
mentions.detail: Past personal injury claims over chemical exposure in clean rooms operated by NXP or former parents Philips and Motorola
mentions.quote: Furthermore, because we continue to utilize these clean rooms, we may become subject to future claims alleging personal injury that may lead to additional liability.
